search.description: Records of one openFDA dataset matching a search (1,000 a page; at most 26,000 rows: skip may not exceed 25,000).

dataset.desc: catalog alias (drug_event) or openFDA path (drug/event) (required; checked by the adapter)

search.desc: openFDA query: field:value, field:"exact phrase", date ranges [20240101 TO 20241231], AND / OR / NOT, _exists_:field

count.description: Counts of records by the values of one field (top 1,000 terms, or a daily time series for a date field).

dataset.desc: catalog alias (drug_event) or openFDA path (drug/event) (required; checked by the adapter)

search.desc: openFDA query: field:value, field:"exact phrase", date ranges [20240101 TO 20241231], AND / OR / NOT, _exists_:field

count.desc: field to count, with .exact for whole phrases (patient.reaction.reactionmeddrapt.exact); a date field gives daily counts

limit.desc: number of terms, at most 1000; default 1000 (all the API returns); without a key the pack sends at most 999 (limit=1000 answers HTTP 403 on some datasets). Ignored by date-field counts

drug_event.name: Drug adverse event reports (FAERS)
drug_event.description: Reports submitted to FDA about adverse events and medication errors; 20.7M reports, 2004-present, updated quarterly

drug_label.name: Drug labeling (SPL)
drug_label.description: Structured product labels: indications, warnings, boxed warnings, dosage

drug_ndc.name: NDC Directory
drug_ndc.description: National Drug Code directory: products, packages, active ingredients, pharm class, DEA schedule

drug_enforcement.name: Drug recall enforcement reports
drug_enforcement.description: Drug recalls with classification (I, II, III), firm, reason, status; enforcement reports from 2012-06-20 on (report_date)

drugsfda.name: Drugs@FDA
drugsfda.description: Approved drug applications (NDA, ANDA, BLA) with submissions and products

drug_shortages.name: Drug shortages
drug_shortages.description: Current, to-be-discontinued and resolved drug shortages: status, therapeutic category, availability; count fields status and therapeutic_category (no .exact); dates are MM/DD/YYYY text

device_event.name: Device adverse events (MAUDE)
device_event.description: Medical device reports of deaths, injuries and malfunctions; 26.5M reports

device_classification.name: Device classification
device_classification.description: Device product codes, class (1, 2, 3), medical specialty, regulation number

device_enforcement.name: Device recall enforcement reports
device_enforcement.description: Device recalls with classification, firm and reason; enforcement reports from 2012-06-20 on (report_date)

device_recall.name: Device recalls (RES)
device_recall.description: Device recall records from the Recall Enterprise System, with root cause

device_pma.name: Premarket approval (PMA)
device_pma.description: PMA decisions for class III devices, including supplements

device_registration.name: Device registration and listing
device_registration.description: Establishments and the devices they list

device_udi.name: Unique Device Identifier (GUDID)
device_udi.description: Device identification records: brand, model, company, sterilization, MRI safety

food_enforcement.name: Food recall enforcement reports
food_enforcement.description: Food (and cosmetics) recalls with classification, firm, reason, distribution; enforcement reports from 2012-06-20 on (report_date)

food_event.name: Food, supplement and cosmetic adverse events (CAERS)
food_event.description: Adverse event reports for foods, dietary supplements and cosmetics

animal_event.name: Animal and veterinary adverse events
animal_event.description: Adverse event reports for animal drugs and devices

tobacco_problem.name: Tobacco product problem reports
tobacco_problem.description: Reports of health and product problems with tobacco and e-cigarette products

historical_document.name: Historical FDA documents
historical_document.description: Press releases and reports, 1913-2014, with OCR text

nsde.name: NDC SPL Data Elements
nsde.description: NDC package-level data elements from SPL files

substance.name: Substance data (GSRS)
substance.description: Substance records: names, codes, structures, relationships

crl.name: Complete response letters
crl.description: FDA complete response letters to drug and biologic applicants
